fusions.name: Heel Drop
fusions.desc: Brings your heel straight down on the target, dealing 16 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hamstring Hew
fusions.desc: A low chopping sweep of the shin that deals 4 damage to every enemy in a cone 2.5 tiles ahead, with a 25% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Feller's Stride
fusions.desc: Your slashing damage rises by 30% for 10 seconds and your movement speed by 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Carried Downswing
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
